## Real camera samples (ORF, RW2)

Real files from [raw.pixls.us](https://raw.pixls.us), each licensed
**CC0 1.0** (Creative Commons Zero, public domain). The licence was checked
against the site's repository index (`/json/getrepository.php?set=all`) by
SHA-256 on 2026-11-28. Each file is **truncated to its first 65,536 bytes**
(CC0 allows modification) to keep the crate small; the capture dates sit in
the first 4.3 KB. URLs are relative to `https://raw.pixls.us/data/`.

| File | Camera, magic | Source | Original bytes, SHA-256 | Truncated SHA-256 | exiftool date of the original |

To recreate one: download the source URL, check its SHA-256, then
`head -c 65536 ORIGINAL > tests/fixtures/NAME`.

**exiftool can't read the dates of the truncated RW2 files**: it stops at the
`JpgFromRaw` block, which points past the cut. The ORF dates still read. When
comparing oxisort with exiftool on these fixtures, compare the RW2 files
against the table above instead.
